{{Quote|My mother was drunk when I got married. This room. Right here. Just like this. I was so angry I don't think I ever forgave her. But I could never understand why she'd done it until just now.|Mon Mothma, to her daughter Leida|<ref name="Harvest" />}}
'''Tanis'''<ref name="Senators" /> was a [[Gender|female]] [[Chandrilan]] and the [[Parent|mother]] of [[Mon Mothma]].<ref name="ROUVG" /> She served as the [[governor]] of<ref name="Senators" /> the Chandrilan [[capital]]<ref name="Life Debt">''[[Aftermath: Life Debt]]''</ref> [[Hanna City]],<ref name="Senators" /> as well as her [[Homeworld|home]] [[planet]] of [[Chandrila]]. Her [[Mon Mothma's father|husband]], who was also the father of her daughter, served the [[Galactic Republic]] as an [[arbiter-general]].<ref name="ROUVG" />

On the day of her fifteen-year-old daughter's [[Marriage|wedding]] to [[Perrin Fertha]], Tanis got [[Alcohol|drunk]]. In her state, she failed to give the bride the chance to back out of an arranged marriage that would ultimately make her unhappy, which became the root of Mon's enduring resentment towards her mother.<ref name="Harvest" />

Toward the end of her life, Tanis fell ill. The last time Mon Mothma and her husband Perrin visited her, the former governor was withering away in bed, arguing about her appetite and refusing her medication.<ref name="MOF">''[[Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear]]''</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
According to Mon Mothma actress [[Genevieve O'Reilly]], the mention of Mothma's mother in "[[Harvest]]" turns the moment into a "really interconnected, intergenerational story."<ref name="YahooNews">{{WebCite|url=https://ca.news.yahoo.com/andor-star-genevieve-oreilly-on-leidas-pretty-brutal-response-to-mon-mothma-before-wedding-021432659.html|text='Andor' star Genevieve O'Reilly on Leida's 'pretty brutal' response to Mon Mothma before wedding|author=Elisabetta Bianchini|date=2025-04-25|work=''Yahoo'' News|archivedate=20250424030919}}</ref>
